name: Feeder backfeed monitoring interface
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Monitors the condition in which an outgoing circuit can energize its supplying bus.
description: Monitors the condition in which an outgoing circuit can energize its supplying bus. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Outgoing source status” at the input and “Backfeed condition indication” at the output. Normal load flow does not rule out another source.
